result:
I've finished planning round 505. The decision is **CONTINUE**, and the next task is written in `current-task.md`. The advisor was available and was consulted at the start, at the closing check and once more before finishing.

**Round 504 accepted.** C passed it with real browser checks and 0 bugs, and it is published at `e3e9e49`. The backlog (now v506) records this from C's evidence only. The owner and upgrade rows were tested with stubbed APIs, so their real-backend half stays open as PURCHASE-REAL-BACKEND. The round-504 task is archived unchanged as `tasks/round-504.md`.

**Round 505: the next "Use Button.tsx only" stage, on the `/support` live chat.**
- **What changes:**
  - "Start Chat" becomes a standard large, full-width `Button`.
  - The icon-only "Send message" becomes `IconButton`. IconButton's brass variant loses its retired glow and its extra press-shrink.
  - Keyboard focus now goes to the message field after a send and after "Start Chat". Today it drops to the page body.
  - If the user moves focus elsewhere while the chat session is still starting, the field does not pull focus back. A browser run with that guard removed confirms the field otherwise steals focus.
- **Not migrated:** the floating `ChatButton` is not mounted by any route, so it can't be checked in a browser. It stays on the dead-code cleanup list, which means this inventory item is not fully closed. The other buttons on the support page belong to a later stage.
- **Checks on the sketch** (outside `store/`, which stays clean at `e3e9e49`):
  - Typecheck passes, lint shows the same 179 warnings as HEAD, and Biome is clean.
  - The covering set passes 80/80, the full suite passes 302 files / 4,373 tests, and the build succeeds.
  - All 15 mutants make their expected rows fail.
  - The patch applies cleanly to a fresh copy of `e3e9e49`.
  - The current code and the sketch were compared in Chromium at 1440, 1280 and 375 with stubbed chat APIs. Each send sends exactly one message request, by click, Enter, double-click or keyboard.
- **Reviews:** product-designer chose the button mapping. The final tech-lead review approves the sketch. An earlier tech-lead objection reasoned from the unused `ChatWidget` file; it was withdrawn once the live `/support` code path was shown.
- **C's rows:** C checks rest, hover, press and focus styling, contrast, validation, message request counts and where focus lands. The real chat backend half is marked blocked in the cloud.

**New items recorded:**
- **Fixed by round 505:** the two focus losses, after "Send message" and after "Start Chat".
- **Deferred Lows:**
  - the browser's own email validation bubble on the guest form;
  - the message field having no proper label;
  - focus after clicking "Live Chat";
  - focus when the user signs in or out while the chat is open;
  - IconButton's double press-shrink on its other variants (info);
  - `store-undefined-tokens` UT2 using up to 73% of its time limit. That is a pre-existing gate-flake risk; it is excluded from the 2.5 s per-test limit in the task, with its time recorded.

Next after this: stage 2e (the LeadMagnet popup, restyle only), then the remaining hand-rolled buttons. A regression round comes first if planning happens on or after 2026-11-16, and RETRO is at round 510.

Main files are in `tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
- `current-task.md`
- `b-round-504.md`
- `b-next.json`
- `feature-status.md`
- `backlog.json`
- `b-round-504/`: patch, reviews, probes, mutants and claims

Sources (for the focus-after-send reference):
- [Discourse Meta: composer loses focus after sending a chat message](https://meta.discourse.org/t/composer-loses-focus-and-keyboard-closes-after-sending-chat-message-on-android/235136)
- [Mozilla Bugzilla 1033334](https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1033334)
